Web-Based Inventory and Sales Monitoring System for DanMil Printing Shop

I helped develop a web-based inventory and sales monitoring system designed to improve the daily operations of DanMil Printing Shop. The system includes sales and transaction recording, inventory and material usage monitoring, automatic bond paper deduction based on printed sheets, low-stock notifications, transaction history, action logs, and sales analytics. It also provides separate admin and staff access to help organize business records and monitor shop operations.

HTML / CSS / JavaScript PHP & SQL Visual Studio Code Web-Based System
